Property.name: Mode
Property.HelpText: Off, Host (others join you) or Join (connect to a host or server). You can also change it in game with F9.

Property.name: Name
Property.HelpText: Shown above your character (up to 10 characters).

Property.name: Host
Property.HelpText: The host's or server's address, e.g. 100.101.102.103. Add :port only if it isn't 43902.

Property.name: Port
Property.HelpText: The UDP port others connect to (default 43902).

Property.name: MyChao
Property.HelpText: The Chao you race and fight with. Easier to pick in game: F9 > My Chao.

Property.name: Visitor1
Property.HelpText: Online, you bring up to 4 Chao from each garden to the shared garden; this is the first. Auto picks the first ones of that garden. Easier to pick in game: F9 > Bring Chao 1.

Property.name: Visitor2
Property.HelpText: Online, you bring up to 4 Chao from each garden to the shared garden; this is the second. Auto picks the first ones of that garden. Easier to pick in game: F9 > Bring Chao 2.

Property.name: Visitor3
Property.HelpText: Online, you bring up to 4 Chao from each garden to the shared garden; this is the third. Auto picks the first ones of that garden. Easier to pick in game: F9 > Bring Chao 3.

Property.name: Visitor4
Property.HelpText: Online, you bring up to 4 Chao from each garden to the shared garden; this is the fourth. Auto picks the first ones of that garden. Easier to pick in game: F9 > Bring Chao 4.

Property.name: OthersChangeChao
Property.HelpText: When other players' feeding, petting and play count for your Chao. Always; ChaoWorld: while you're anywhere in Chao World (gardens, lobby, Kindergarten, races, karate); ThatGarden: while you're in the garden your Chao is in; Never. Otherwise they can still see, carry, throw and pet them, but nothing reaches your save. Also in game: F9 > Others can change my Chao.

Property.name: RoomMode
Property.HelpText: Race: everyone has their own enemies. Coop: enemies someone destroys are gone for everyone.

Property.name: SkinVoiceVolume
Property.HelpText: How loud skins' voices are, 0 to 150 (100 = as the skin makes them). Also in game: F9 > Skin voices.

Property.name: GameVolume
Property.HelpText: The whole game's volume: music, sounds, voices and skins (the game has no volume option of its own). Also in game: F9 > Game volume.

Property.name: StageSync
Property.HelpText: In party Co-op stages, enemies, bosses and mech lock-ons are shared between players. Turn this off if a party stage misbehaves; everything else stays shared.

Property.name: ChaoRace
Property.HelpText: Friends' Chao fill the other lanes in your Chao Races.

Property.name: PlayerKey
Property.HelpText: Made by the mod the first time it runs: servers know your Chao by it, so the ones you leave in a shared garden are still yours next time. Leave it as it is and don't share it.

Property.name: GbaRom
Property.display: GBA ROM (your own, game code BPEE)
Property.HelpText: Path to your own GBA ROM (game code BPEE). Empty: the first .gba file in the mod's gba folder. Names, types and pictures are read from it.

Property.name: GbaSave
Property.HelpText: Path to the 128 KB save of that game. Empty: the first .sav file in the mod's gba folder. It is only read, never changed. In game: F9 > GBA link.
